using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly TestFailoverSession _session;

        public ReplicaFailoverSessionLoggerTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            _session = new TestFailoverSession(_mockLogger.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync_LogsWarning_WhenBeginRecoveryFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            _session.ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Setup(x => x.BeginRecovery(It.IsAny<RecoveryStatus>(), false)).Returns(false);

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Warning),
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync: {logMessage}")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync_LogsWarning_WhenTryTakeOverForPrimaryFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            _session.ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Setup(x => x.BeginRecovery(It.IsAny<RecoveryStatus>(), false)).Returns(true);
            _session.ClusterProvider.ClusterManager.Setup(x => x.TryTakeOverForPrimary()).Returns(false);

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Warning),
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync: {logMessage}")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync_LogsWarning_WhenInitializeCheckpointStoreFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            _session.ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Setup(x => x.BeginRecovery(It.IsAny<RecoveryStatus>(), false)).Returns(true);
            _session.ClusterProvider.ClusterManager.Setup(x => x.TryTakeOverForPrimary()).Returns(true);
            _session.ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Setup(x => x.InitializeCheckpointStore()).Returns(false);

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync();

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Warning),
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Failed acquiring latest memory checkpoint metadata at TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test double that exposes the private method and dependencies
    internal class TestFailoverSession
    {
        internal ILogger<FailoverSession> Logger { get; }
        internal TestClusterProvider ClusterProvider { get; }
        internal TestClusterConfig OldConfig { get; }
        internal System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource Cts { get; }
        internal long Epoch = 1;
        internal FailoverStatus Status = FailoverStatus.None;
        internal TimeSpan FailoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

        internal TestFailoverSession(ILogger<FailoverSession> logger)
        {
            Logger = logger;
            ClusterProvider = new TestClusterProvider();
            OldConfig = new TestClusterConfig();
            Cts = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
        }

        internal async Task<bool> TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync()
        {
            // Direct copy of the method body from ReplicaFailoverSession.cs
            Status = FailoverStatus.TAKING_OVER_AS_PRIMARY;
            var acquiredLock = false;

            try
            {
                if (!ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Object.BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus.ClusterFailover, upgradeLock: false))
                {
                    Logger.LogWarning($"{nameof(TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync)}: {{logMessage}}", Encoding.ASCII.GetString(CmdStrings.RESP_ERR_GENERIC_CANNOT_ACQUIRE_RECOVERY_LOCK));
                    return false;
                }
                acquiredLock = true;
                // Skip async calls that would require more mocking
                await Task.Yield();

                if (!ClusterProvider.ClusterManager.Object.TryTakeOverForPrimary())
                {
                    Logger.LogWarning($"{nameof(TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync)}: {{logMessage}}", Encoding.ASCII.GetString(CmdStrings.RESP_ERR_GENERIC_CANNOT_TAKEOVER_FROM_PRIMARY));
                    return false;
                }

                ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Object.TryUpdateForFailover();
                ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Object.ResetReplayIterator();

                if (!ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Object.InitializeCheckpointStore())
                    Logger.LogWarning("Failed acquiring latest memory checkpoint metadata at {method}", nameof(TakeOverAsPrimaryAsync));
                await Task.Yield();

                ClusterProvider.StoreWrapper.Object.StartPrimaryTasks();
            }
            finally
            {
                if (acquiredLock) ClusterProvider.ReplicationManager.Object.EndRecovery(RecoveryStatus.NoRecovery, downgradeLock: false);
            }

            return true;
        }
    }

    internal class TestClusterConfig
    {
        public string LocalNodeId => "test-node";
        public string LocalNodePrimaryId => "primary-node";
        public string GetEndpointFromNodeId(string nodeId) => "localhost:6379";
    }

    internal class TestClusterProvider
    {
        internal Mock<IRepManager> ReplicationManager { get; } = new();
        internal Mock<IClusterManager> ClusterManager { get; } = new();
        internal Mock<IStoreWrapper> StoreWrapper { get; } = new();
    }

    // Minimal interfaces matching the field accesses
    internal interface IRepManager
    {
        bool BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus status, bool upgradeLock);
        void EndRecovery(RecoveryStatus status, bool downgradeLock);
        bool InitializeCheckpointStore();
        void TryUpdateForFailover();
        void ResetReplayIterator();
    }

    internal interface IClusterManager
    {
        bool TryTakeOverForPrimary();
    }

    internal interface IStoreWrapper
    {
        void StartPrimaryTasks();
    }

    internal enum FailoverStatus { None, TAKING_OVER_AS_PRIMARY }
    internal enum RecoveryStatus { NoRecovery, ClusterFailover }

    internal static class CmdStrings
    {
        public static ReadOnlyMemory<byte> RESP_ERR_GENERIC_CANNOT_ACQUIRE_RECOVERY_LOCK { get; } = 
            Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("CANNOT_ACQUIRE_RECOVERY_LOCK");
        public static ReadOnlyMemory<byte> RESP_ERR_GENERIC_CANNOT_TAKEOVER_FROM_PRIMARY { get; } = 
            Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("CANNOT_TAKEOVER_FROM_PRIMARY");
    }
}
